claim: 6.03 MPa is the source paper's simulation, not a measured pressure test.
why_load_bearing: Changes validation strength of the benchmark.
reviewer_finding: EUCASS2023-367 §§3.1–3.2.1: experiments validate axial compression; 6.03 MPa is a pressure-postbuckling prediction.

claim: Refined midsurface indentation peak 6.159021 MPa; scenario range 6.1590–6.5023 MPa.
why_load_bearing: Determines claimed agreement and ambiguity with the benchmark.
reviewer_finding: Independent force equilibrium at the saved refined state gives 6.159020624266 MPa; original 6.159020624174. Independent raw-path maxima give 6.159020624–6.502271779 MPa. Scope: frozen-state equilibrium and sampled maxima, not a rerun of contact/plastic history or proof of physical instability.

claim: Peak differences: +2.140% to 6.03 MPa, contact refinement −0.1156%, penalty doubling −0.0105%.
why_load_bearing: Supports the convergence and accuracy headline.
reviewer_finding: Independent ratios: +2.139645510%, mesh −0.115571622%, penalty −0.010452458%. These reproduce the printed rounding; they are observed numerical changes, not certified error bounds.

why_load_bearing: Tests the radius-reading sensitivity independently of plastic calibration.
reviewer_finding: Fresh Q8 elastic/prestress eigenproblems give 30.218153613699 MPa outer-radius and 28.074312431918 MPa midsurface-radius: +9.764451920% and +1.977161031% relative to 27.53 MPa.

claim: No P2 gamma released; directional CR III law still required.
why_load_bearing: Prevents numerical benchmark agreement becoming hull capacity.
reviewer_finding: Withholding P2 gamma is supported: the benchmark is steel/PVC with unresolved calibration; Hexcel supplies distinct directional anchors, not a matched installed CR III crush/unload/mixed-load law.

claim: 047 is inadmissible as a physical manufacturing tolerance.
why_load_bearing: Controls whether target amplitudes can be used for fabrication acceptance.
reviewer_finding: The source record supports withholding physical tolerance release: 345 MPa is a tensile proxy; the in-plane core law, processed compression/bond and manufactured residual state remain unqualified.

claim: SR-200 E=290 GPa is sourced, with sheet/form/allowable limits.
why_load_bearing: Sets the material stiffness for every shape target.
reviewer_finding: Materion SR-200 p.1 lists representative scalar E=290 GPa. Its mechanical minimums are tensile; the source does not identify a finished, formed, biaxial compressive allowable.

claim: The light bond film is 2U; its identity is sourced, with limits.
why_load_bearing: Sets a joining-mass credit and the admissibility of the proposed construction route.
reviewer_finding: 3M p.1 lists unsupported AF 163-2U at 0.015 lb/ft². Its p.15 200°F table concerns 2K 0.060 lb/ft², so product identity does not qualify the proposed Be/CR III process.

claim: Cure-debited SF1.05 amplitude at R10 is 0.793 mm.
reviewer_finding: Eliminating C between source and target equations gives 0.792569717998 mm at R10, SF1.05, with the declared cure debit.

claim: Cure-debited SF1.05 amplitude at R20 is 1.628 mm.
reviewer_finding: The independent ratio gives 1.628412576678 mm at R20 under the same declared hypothesis.

claim: Cure-debited SF1.05 amplitude at R30 is 2.486 mm.
reviewer_finding: The independent ratio gives 2.485983493740 mm at R30 under the same declared hypothesis.

claim: The stated amplitude scaling law transfers the radius/face-core geometry.
why_load_bearing: Determines whether the three sizes share a defensible target family.
reviewer_finding: Under homothety, R/tf and tc/tf are constant, so membrane stress, scaled residual debit and C are constant; d and allowed amplitude scale with R. This is a dimensional consequence of the hypothesis, not validation of C transfer.
Independent stock/labor/material arithmetic and supplied facility allowances reproduce $66,519,656.56–477,421,594.60. Rates are unquoted assumptions.

claim: R20 first-shell route costs $522.8 million–3.814 billion.
All six complete mass bills have negative payload with concept growth.
reviewer_finding: All six negative signs reproduce, but inherited coating growth overcharges the stated 20% total allowance. Payload rises 0.095193/0.380771/0.856735 kg at R10/20/30 after removing the embedded-margin denominator error. Six unreviewed field corrections are listed in FIXES.json.

claim: Seven precedent records distinguish RMS, fit and maximum local defects.
why_load_bearing: Controls whether manufacturing examples demonstrate the target tolerance.
reviewer_finding: Seven records preserve the missing local-defect metrics. Spot checks confirm ALMA's adjusted/masked 16–17 µm RMS and S-II's 0.010 inch core-to-face gap; neither establishes this hull's maximum local defect.
